from pathlib import Path
import collections, json
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Find the full-width or full-height colored guide line.
    guide = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row[0] != bg and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            guide = ("row", r, row[0]); break
    if guide is None:
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[0][c]
            if v != bg and all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)):
                guide = ("col", c, v); break
    if guide is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    axis, pos, guide_color = guide
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Preserve the guide, and collect all other non-background cells as one shape.
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and not (r == pos if axis == "row" else c == pos)]
    if axis == "row":
        for c in range(w): out[pos][c] = guide_color
        if not cells: return out
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c,v in cells), max(r for r,c,v in cells)
        if hi < pos: delta = (pos - 1) - hi
        elif lo > pos: delta = (pos + 1) - lo
        else: delta = 0
        moved = [(r + delta, c, v) for r,c,v in cells]
        far = min(r for r,c,v in moved) if (min(r for r,c,v in moved) > pos) else max(r for r,c,v in moved)
        stripe = far + (1 if far > pos else -1)
        if 0 <= stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        for r in range(h): out[r][pos] = guide_color
        if not cells: return out
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c,v in cells), max(c for r,c,v in cells)
        if hi < pos: delta = (pos - 1) - hi
        elif lo > pos: delta = (pos + 1) - lo
        else: delta = 0
        moved = [(r, c + delta, v) for r,c,v in cells]
        far = min(c for r,c,v in moved) if min(c for r,c,v in moved) > pos else max(c for r,c,v in moved)
        stripe = far + (1 if far > pos else -1)
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][stripe] = 8
    for r,c,v in moved:
        if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w: out[r][c] = v
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'), globals())
